parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
An alkene, a carboxylic acid and a ketone, all of similar volatility, are mixed together. The mixture is then analysed by gas chromatography.

The gas chromatogram produced is shown.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

The separation of the three compounds depends on their relative solubilities in the liquid stationary phase. The liquid stationary phase is an alkane.
parts.text:
(i) Complete the table to suggest which compound in the mixture is responsible for each peak **J**, **K** and **L**. Explain your answer by reference to the intermolecular forces of each compound.

| peak | organic compound | explanation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **J** |  |  |
| **K** |  |  |
| **L** |  |  |

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.stem:
A student calculates the areas underneath the three peaks in the chromatogram.

| peak | **J** | **K** | **L** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $area/mm^2$ | 46 | 18 | 28 |
parts.text:
(ii) The area underneath each peak is proportional to the mass of the respective compound.

Calculate the percentage **by mass** in the original mixture of the compound responsible for peak **K**.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Chlorobenzene can be prepared from benzene as shown.  Aluminium chloride, $AlCl_3$, catalyses this reaction.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}
parts.text: (i) Write an equation to show how $AlCl_3$ generates the electrophile needed in this reaction.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: (ii) Draw the mechanism of the reaction between this electrophile and benzene to form chlorobenzene. Include all relevant curly arrows and charges.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: (iii) Write an equation to show how the catalyst is regenerated.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
(i) Catalysts can be heterogeneous or homogeneous.

Explain what is meant by a homogeneous catalyst.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
(ii) Complete the table by placing **one** tick (✓) in **each row** to indicate the mode of action of the catalyst in each reaction.

|  | heterogeneous | homogeneous |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Rh in the removal of $NO_2$ from exhaust gases of cars |  |  |
| $Fe^{3+}$ in the $I^-/S_2O_8^{2-}$ reaction |  |  |
